request.style: English, female solo voice with warm choir, piano, acoustic guitar, cello, soft drums, hopeful and building, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Poor in spirit, the kingdom is yours
Mourning hearts will find comfort in store
Meek in spirit, the earth is the prize
Hunger and thirst, with open wide eyes

[Chorus]
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness
For they will be filled
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness
For they will be filled

[Verse]
Merciful spirits, mercy will flow
Pure in heart, you will see God’s glow
Peacemakers rise, called God’s own sons
The beatitudes speak, the victory won

[Chorus]
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness
For they will be filled
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness
For they will be filled

[Bridge]
Not by our own strength, but by grace
The hunger is met in a holy place

[Chorus]
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness
For they will be filled
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness
For they will be filled

[Outro]
Filled with the promise, filled with the light
Hungering for what is right
